title: Cobalt Changes
description: Essential additions for the Cobalt Clouds Modpack
body:
Cobalt Changes is a mod designed for use in the modpack Cobalt Clouds.
It can be used outside of this pack, but this is not reccomended since there are no inherent recipes.
- Adds 2 new ores, Cobalt and Vanadium which spawn in the upper island levels
- Adds respective materials for each ore alongside crafting components.
- Does not add any recipes, use KubeJS or a similar mod to add these features.
